messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as hubs for airlines:

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta | Georgia | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles | California | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and United. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago | Illinois | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the world; hub for United and American. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas/Fort Worth | Texas | DFW | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver | Colorado | DEN | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City | New York | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for Delta and American. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco | California | SFO | Hub for United and a major gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle | Washington | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a major gateway to Asia. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami | Florida | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines and a key gateway to Latin America. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix | Arizona | PHX | Hub for American Airlines; major domestic hub. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte | North Carolina | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando | Florida | MCO | Major hub for Southwest; key gateway to theme parks and leisure travelers. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark | New Jersey | EWR | Major hub for United; key gateway to New York City. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit | Michigan | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Washington, D.C. | Virginia | IAD | Major hub for United; key gateway to the nation's capital. |

These airports serve as major hubs for airlines, handle a large volume of passengers, and often have extensive international connections.
